messages:
laura_pm: Quick heads-up — Saturn (private) rollout is planned for Tue 03/25 02:00 UTC. Need final lock/approval on change window and canary success metrics. Will pin to image tag `saturn-v2.3.1` for this rollout.

maria_eng: Ack. Can we confirm fallback pin to `saturn-v2.2.8` if we hit regressions?

eric_release: Yes, plan is: pin to v2.3.1, canary 10% traffic for 20m, then 50% for 30m. If error_rate > 1% or p50 latency increases > 2x vs baseline during any gate we abort and trigger rollback to v2.2.8.

alok_sre: FYI SLOs: p50 baseline 110ms, p95 420ms. I'll set an alert if p50 > 250ms sustained for 10m or 5xx rate > 0.8%. Those thresholds will be our automatic gates.

laura_pm: Good. Also want to lock DB migrations — there are none for this release, verified by @maria_eng. :white_check_mark:

maria_eng: confirmed no schema changes. Just runtime and quantization config tweaks.

deploybot: [deploybot] preflight checks starting for tenant=saturn image=saturn-v2.3.1
deploybot: [deploybot] build verification: ok
deploybot: [deploybot] infra quota check: ok (dedicated pool saturn-ded-1)

jun_support: Can we add a short note in the release log about the embedding change? A few customers saw subtle drift in small benchmarks last cycle.

eric_release: Good call. I'll append the release notes with a short eval summary and rollback steps. Link: https://redwood.internal/release-notes/saturn-v2.3.1 (internal)

alok_sre: One operational ask: during canary please keep devex tracing on and don't purge KV cache between slices so we can measure steady-state. Also leave a pinned ticket for rollback runbook.

maria_eng: Will enable tracing and pin the rollback runbook (ticket #INC-4592). Also enabling conservative batching config for canary to reduce token spikes.

laura_pm: Do we have approvers on this thread? I need two +1s for the window and rollback policy. @alok_sre @eric_release @maria_eng please react.

alok_sre: +1 (locks & alerting in place)
maria_eng: +1 (pin + config set)
eric_release: +1 (release notes & rollback ready)

laura_pm: Great — window locked. Deploybot, schedule canary for Tue 03/25 02:00 UTC. If any gate fails auto-rollback to `saturn-v2.2.8` is allowed.

deploybot: [deploybot] scheduled: tenant=saturn start=2318803200 window=2026-03-25T02:00:00Z canary=10%/20m -> 50%/30m auto_rollback=true fallback_image=saturn-v2.2.8

jun_support: I'll stand by for any customer-facing messages; slack me if we rollback so we can update support docs quickly.

eric_release: I'll post a short summary in #customer-success after the canary completes.

laura_pm: Thanks everyone. I'll close the RFC after the deploy completes. :rocket:
